name: 🧀 Cheesy Quesadillas
tagline: Golden, crispy, extra-cheesy quesadillas: the 20-minute no-meat dinner everyone builds their own way.

steps.text: Oven to 250°F to keep the finished ones warm. Put a sheet pan inside.
Lay out the tortillas. Sprinkle cheese over half of each, edge to edge, then fold over.
Melt a little butter in a big skillet over medium.
Cook 2–3 at a time, pressing down with a spatula, until golden and the cheese is melted.
Move finished ones to the warm oven while you cook the rest.
Mash the avocado with salt (and lime if you have it) for a quick guac.
Cut each one into 3 wedges with a pizza cutter and serve with sour cream, salsa and guac.

kid_jobs.job: Cut wedges with a pizza cutter (cooled a bit)
Set out the dips and the table

chef_tip: Medium heat, not high: the cheese needs time to melt before the tortilla burns. A light press with the spatula makes them crispy all over.
make_ahead: Fold them up to a day ahead and keep them covered in the fridge; cook just before dinner.
leftovers: Re-crisp in a dry skillet or the air fryer for 3–4 minutes. Good in a lunch box cold, too.
swaps: Add black beans or corn inside
Add shredded chicken for meat eaters
serve_with: Salsa, sour cream, guac, and cut-up peppers or a simple salad

game_plan.what: Oven to 250°F with a sheet pan inside.
Kids fill and fold the tortillas.
Cook in batches; finished ones into the warm oven.
Kids mash the guac and set out the dips.
Cut into wedges and serve hot.
